George Kennan

Henry Kissinger

mcqs.q: What was the Western response to the 1948 Berlin Blockade?

Berlin Airlift
NATO invasion
Nuclear ultimatum

mcqs.q: What caused the First World War?
options: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand caused the war.
Long-term tensions (militarism, alliances, imperialism, nationalism) combined with the July Crisis triggered by the assassination of Franz Ferdinand.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
Germany declared war on Britain to seize colonies.
